merchant/32878.htm.text: Recipe Merchant Sparky: Hey, got a sec? I'm too cooped up here! Just take a look outside, see that open sky? I don't know how much more I can take! I want to be free! But I have so many customers, I can't just abandon this place. Then again, if I didn't have customers, I'd be complaining about that…
